text:
Asha: @here p99 spiked to ~5.2s across canary v14 in us-west-2, starting ~4990012320. Seeing streaming stalls (clients see long pauses during chunked responses). Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/infra/dashboards/canary-v14-p99
Derek: taking this. Paging now. any customer-impact flags?
Beth (CS): I have one enterprise customer on a test plane hitting v14 shadowed traffic; no outage reports yet but their telemetry shows increased retry counts. I'll pre-alert them if we decide to rollback.
SRE-Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-499001 - Canary v14 latency spike (p95/p99). Notifying oncall.
Marta: quick check: encoder mutex wait time increased in the same window, also KV cache eviction rate doubled. Could be quant or kernel change in v14.
Derek: good catch. can we see per-model kernel mapping?
Asha: yes — v14 switched to int8-kernel-v2 for the encoder. p99 correlates with increased L2 misses in perf traces.
Derek: run quick smoke to confirm rollback reduces p99. If yes, we should do immediate rollback on canary traffic and hold.
DeployBot: Canary rollout v14 -> traffic 10% (started). Current distribution: v14=8%, v13=92%.
Derek: set canary to 0% and shift to v13, hold deploy.
Marta: on it. running route change:
```sh
# shift canary to 0%
redwood route update --deployment canary-v14 --weight 0 --region us-west-2
```
Marta: applied. waiting for metrics to settle (~30s).
SRE-Bot: Audit event: route update by Marta at 4990012349.
Asha: p99 dropped to 1.1s in rolling windows after change, p95 back to baseline. streaming stalls appear to have stopped.
Derek: nice. keep traffic pinned to v13 and abort v14 rollout for now. also capture traces and perf counters for a postmortem.
Marta: aborting rollout:
```sh
redwood rollout abort --id canary-v14 --reason "p99/regression-int8-kernel-v2"
```
DeployBot: Rollout abort accepted. Canary v14 stopped.
Beth (CS): I'll let the customer know we paused the canary and are investigating root cause; offer them status update in 1h.
Derek: assign follow-ups: 1) perf team to diff kernel v2/v1 counters (Marta), 2) infra to validate L2 miss surface (Asha), 3) eng-ml to reproduce with stress harness (Marta + Derek). set sev2 for now.
Asha: collecting traces and samples. uploading perf flamegraphs to https://redwood.internal/storage/canary-v14-499001
Derek: quick triage notes: p99 jumps localized to long-tail streaming requests that keep KV cache entries warm for longer. hypothesis: int8-kernel-v2 has different memory access pattern leading to higher L2/cache miss under multiplexed streams.
Marta: adding kernel revert option to experiment matrix. also adding larger warmup for KV cache on canary attempts.
SRE-Bot: Incident INC-2026-499001 status: mitigated (canary rollback). assigned: Marta, Asha, Derek.
Beth (CS): Customer notification sent: "We paused a canary rollout after detecting increased latency; no confirmed user-facing failures. We are investigating and will follow up in 60 minutes"
Derek: thanks. if metrics stay stable for 30m we can close page and move to postmortem. otherwise escalate.
Asha: saving capture and logs. attaching quick snippet of encoder thread dump:
```
ENCODER THREAD WAIT:  0.002s -> 0.614s (hotspots at quant_kernel_apply, memcopy)
KV EVICT RATE: 2.3x baseline
```
Marta: adding regression alert to prevent future silent canaries.
Derek: handoff to follow-up owners: please make a short runbook entry describing kernel toggles and how to revert, and include the exact commands we used. I'll update incident ticket with timeline.
Beth (CS): noted, will keep customer updated.
Asha: thanks all. marking live mitigation complete. :white_check_mark: 
Derek: closing paging state in 30m if stable.
DeployBot: Incident INC-2026-499001 updated: mitigated at 4990012367."
